name: Progressive (Social)
body:
This race trait is available to dwarves, gnomes, goblins, and vulture-men. Your race affords you technological advancements beyond others.

Benefit: Firearms are available to you as one category better (very rare, emerging, and so on). You can craft firearms if you possess the Craft Magic Arms and Armor item creation feat.
